shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
circular/disc motif (arguably in B's chest area)
justification: A is an inscribed slab densely covered with rows of small repeated abstract sign-like elements filling the whole field, while B is a monolithic anthropomorphic figure with a head, headdress and torso bearing a few large emblematic motifs including a disc on the chest and a belt-like band. The only correspondence is the generic use of shallow incised relief and the presence of a circular motif; there is no shared figural scheme, arrangement or relationship between elements.
